context: M11 o1. Rita's bar, afternoon. Delphine sets out her day.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Brannock's car's been on Thirty-Eighth since noon. Watching the door.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Then we move the club's money today. While he's watching the wrong door.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Where to? Under the bed? Under my bed?

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Boiler room. Marcus's boiler room. Nobody steals from a boiler.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Collect the Royal first. Tina's always late. Today, be early.
